गजपिप्पली: गजपिप्पली (1) SCINDAPSUS OFFICINALIS SCHOTT = POTHOS OFFICINALIS ROXB. (2) LITSEA POLYANTHA JUSS. (KB 3, p. 2160-2161); (3) L. SEBIFERA PERS. = TETRANTHERA APETALA ROXB. (ROXB., p. 734) = TOMEX SEBIFERA WILLD. (Roxb., p. 734).
गण्डीर: गण्डीर (1) a) a particular plant eaten as a vegetable (PW; Vśs); b) a kind of potherb described as growing in watery ground (Kav; MW), but acc. to some a species of cucumber (MW); (2) RUBIA CORDIFOLIA LINN. (HB; Vśs); (3) EUPHORBIA NERIIFOLIA LINN. (DWH 3, p. 253-257; Vśs); (4) E. ANTIQUORUM LINN. (DWH 3, p. 253-257; Vśs); (5) SOLANUM VERBASCIFOLIUM LINN. (KB 3, p. 1753-1754); (6) S. PUBESCENS WILLD. (Roxb., p. 189); (7) = कटुशरण (Vśs, unidentified); (8) = शमठ (Cakra on Ca. Sū. 27, 106; unidentified); Cakra on Ca. Sū. 27, 171: “गण्डीर is of two kinds: red and white; the red type has been described as a pungent potherb, the white type grows in water;” Ḍa. on Su. Ci. 4, 32: “गण्डीर is of two kinds: terrestrial and aquatic; the terrestrial type is a vegetable, the aquatic type is जल-पिप्पलीगण्डीर” (see जलपिप्पली).
गन्धक: गन्धक MORINGA OLEIFERA LAM. = M. PTERYGOSPERMA GAERTN. (KB 1, p. 677-682; MW; PW; Vśs).
गन्धपत्र: गन्धपत्र (1) a) MAJORANA HORTENSIS MOENCH. [Intern. Code] = ORIGANUM MAJORANA LINN. (KB 3, p. 1985-1986); b) = मरुवक (PW; Vśs); (2) a) the white type of तुलसी (PW; Vśs); b) = बर्बर (PW; Vśs); (3) = बिल्व (PW; Vśs); (4) = नागरङ्ग: CITRUS AURANTIUM LINN. (PW; Vśs); see Watt CP, p. 320-321. (5) = तेजपत्र (see पत्र) (Vśs); (6) the leaves of प्रसारणी (Vśs); (7) a partic. kind of सुगन्धपत्रा = रुद्रजटा (Vśs; Nadk. 1, nr. 229: रुद्रजटा = ARISTOLOCHIA INDICA LINN.).
गुञ्जा: गुञ्जा ABRUS PRECATORIUS LINN. = A. MINOR DESV. (Nadk. 1, nr. 6) = A. PAUCIFLORUS DESV. (Nadk. 1, nr. 6) = GLYCINE ABRUS LINN.
गुडूची: गुडूची (1) [TINOSPORA CORDIFOLIA (WILLD.) MIERS] (Bpn, p. 269-270; Chopra) = T. CORDIFOLIA MIERS (Avk; Dgm, p. 25; Dgv, nr. 14; Dutt; DWH 1, p. 54-56; Gul; HB; HK; Kav; KB 1, p. 77-80; Na 1, nr. 12; Nadk. 1, nr. 2472; PA 1, 7, p. 13-27; Sanyal; V 3, p. 86; Vśs) = MENISPERMUM CORDIFOLIUM WILLD. (Dutt; HK; Kav; KB 1, p. 77-80; Nadk. 1, nr. 2472; PA 1, 7, p. 13-27; Vśs) [= M. CORDIFOLIUM RUSSELL] (Ainslie 2, p. 377-378) = M. GLABRUM BURM. F. (PA 1, 7, p. 13-27) = COCCULUS CORDIFOLIUS DC. (HK; MW; Nadk. 1, nr. 2472; PA 1, 7, p. 13-27; PW); (2) TINOSPORA CRISPA MIERS (DWH 1, p. 64: known by the same vernacular names as T. CORDIFOLIA; PA 1, 7, p. 32, footnote: used sometimes as a substitute) = MENISPERMUM CRISPUM LINN.; (3) T. MALABARICA MIERS (PA 1, 7, p. 32, footnote: used sometimes as a substitute) = MENISPERMUM MALABARICUM LAM.; (4) T. TOMENTOSA MIERS (PA 1, 7, p. 32, footnote: used sometimes as a substitute; PA considers 3) and 4) as synonyms) = MENISPERMUM TOMENTOSUM ROXB.
गोक्षुर: गोक्षुर (क) (1) TRIBULUS TERRESTRIS LINN. (Avk; Bpn, p. 292-293; Chopra; Dgv, nr. 60; Dutt; DWH 1, p. 243-245; Dy, p. 119-120; Ghosh; Gul; HB; HK; Kav; KB 1, p. 420-423; Na 1, nr. 83; Nadk. 1, nr. 2496; PA 1, 2, p. 75-79; Sanyal; V 3, p. 128) = T. LANUGINOSUS LINN. (Dutt; HK; Kav; MW; Nadk. 1, nr. 2496) [= T. ZEYLANICUS] (Nadk. 1, nr. 2496); (2) T. ALATUS DELILE (Bpn, p. 292-293: may be used as a substitute); (3) PEDALIUM MUREX LINN. (Bpn, p. 292-293: बृहद्गोक्षुर; KB 3, p. 1856-1857; PA 1, 2, p. 75, footnote: considered by some as a large form of गोक्षुर); (4) HYGROPHILA SPINOSA T. ANDERS. = ASTERACANTHA LONGIFOLIA NEES (MW; PW); (5) BARLERIA LONGIFLORA LINN. F. (KB 3, p. 1882).
गोजिह्वा: गोजिह्वा (1) ELEPHANTOPUS SCABER LINN. (Avk; Bpn, p. 471-472; Chopra; Dutt; DWH 2, p. 243-244; Dy, p. 423; Gul; HK; IRM 3, p. 149; Kav; KB 2, p. 1328-1330; MW; Na 1, nr. 290; Nadk. 1, nr. 923; PW: acc. to Wilson; Sanyal; Vśs); (2) ONOSMA BRACTEATUM WALL. (Bpn, p. 471-472; Dgv, nr. 222); (3) LEUCAS ASPERA LINK = PHLOMIS ESCULENTA ROXB. (MW; PW: possibly, acc. to Colebr.); (4) PREMNA ESCULENTA ROXB. (MW; PW: acc. to Haught. गोजिआ designates, in Beng., P.E. ROXB.); (5) a species of HIERACIUM (MW; PW: acc. to Haught.); (6) POLYTOCA BARBATA STAPF = CHIONACHNE BARBATA R. BR. = COIX BARBATA ROXB. (MW; PW: = गवेधुका, but, acc. to KB 4, p. 2655-2656, गवेधुका designates COIX LACHRYMA-JOBI LINN.); (7) = दार्विका (PW; unidentified, but probably = दार्वी).
ग्रन्थि: ग्रन्थि (1) the root of PIPER LONGUM LINN. (MW); (2) CYNODON DACTYLON (LINN.) PERS. [Intern. Code] (DWH 3, p. 577; Nadk. 1, nr. 772); (3) CYPERUS ROTUNDUS LINN. (KB 4, p. 2638-2640); (4) = ग्रन्थिपर्ण (MW; PW; Vśs); (5) = पिण्डालु (MW; PW; Vśs); (6) = भद्रमुस्ता (MW; PW; Vśs); (7) = हितावली (MW; PW; unidentified).
ग्रन्थिपर्ण: ग्रन्थिपर्ण (1) POLYGONUM AVICULARE LINN. (Bpn, p. 252); (2) ARTEMISIA VULGARIS LINN. (KB 2, p. 1395-1397); (3) a particular fragrant plant (MW; PW); (4) = चोरक (MW; PW; Vśs).
गुग्गुलु: गुग्गुलु usually designates the gum of COMMIPHORA MUKUL ENGL.; (12) CINNAMOMUM TAMALA T. NEES ET EBERM. (KB 3, p. 2146-2147); (13) [C. ZEYLANICUM BREYN] (see त्वच्) (KB 3, p. 2149-2150); (14) Cassia-bark (MW; PW); (15) myrrh (MW; PW).
गृध्रनखी: gṛdhranakhī (1) Hygrophila auriculata (Schum.) Heine = H. spinosa T. Anders. (HK: = kokilākṣa); (2) Capparis sepiaria Linn. (Na 1, nr. 35; KB 1, p. 199-200); (3) C. zeylanica Linn. (Bt.; VG); (4) Zizyphus species (Bt.; cf. Nś. 70cd-71: = badarī).
गोल्ल: golla Sbm. 4, 137 mentions a golajakaṣāya, comm. aśvatthaphalaṃ loke ‘gola’ nāmnā vyavahriyate. golaka = takkola acc. to comm. on Haram. 5, 129. takkola is difficult to identify; acc. to S.N. Yoganarasimhan and V.S. Togunashi in SCA 31, 8, Feb. 1979, p. 764 it is Vitex altissima Linn. f. Bheṣajakalpa 64 mentions takkola (not identified in the notes). tak-kola = kakkola acc. to Vśs; kakkola is sometimes identified as Piper cubeba Linn. f. (Sharma; Bt.).
